title: Classify all alpha74 directions for one fixed P112 cover
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3307 fixed U7,V4 cover, one common cut of at most two roots
  eight named normals: predecessor result
  ALL qualifying directions: complete classification here
  exact eligible lines = normals whose own root is in the cut
  total qualifying span <= 2 on this cover
```

Add only `research/p112-alpha74-fixed-cover-complete/`. This closes PR3307's explicit fixed-cover completeness handoff over every characteristic-zero field. The original universal arbitrary-cover span-at-most-five question remains **UNSETTLED**. No literal caller or kappa claim follows.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3307 and PR3289, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, the canonical PR3161/3162 geometry and retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. Exact predecessor proof/witness bytes, source pins, the written proof and Open next questions are included. The card scope was explicitly narrowed to this finite side result before freeze. Concurrent PR3322 excludes the motivating historical caller through a distinct one-seven-flat/common-six theorem; that result is credited and unused here. This PR claims only the fixed-cover classification.

## Evidence

- Before, the common-cut bound covered only eight exhibited normals. After, all 43,435 binary seven-spaces are checked. Only eight spaces have candidate small cuts; all 320 exact rational candidate nullspaces are the known one-dimensional normal lines.
- The primary implementation uses incremental dependencies over F101. A second uses transpose RREF over F103, reversed root order and a different seven-space enumeration. Both accept only exact rational nullspaces. Controls cover modular singleton supersets, actual corrupted-source rejection and JSON schema types. Source/model helpers are shared.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, Ruff and committed-byte checks pass. All three actual scripts pass under optimized CPython 3.13 in the final committed read-only Git-free export, with unchanged hashes. The designated scoped read-only peer receipt is retained in REVIEW.json.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-alpha74-fixed-cover-complete
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only one opt-in package. The arbitrary-cover universal predicate, historical caller, full C5, global decoder floor, native/physical/restoration/consumer costs, supplier and selected frontier remain outside scope. Historical heavy censuses, Lean, Docker, selected cold replay and human/proof-kernel review are unrun. Archival intake is not scientific admission.
